lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) (f : E → ℝ),
    ContDiff ℝ 2 f → MemLp f 2 μ → MemLp (gradient f) 2 μ →
    Integrable (fun x => (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2)) μ →
    let fn := fun n : ℕ => fun x : E => radialSmoothCutoff ((n:ℝ)+1) x * f x
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, (fn n x)^2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂μ)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, (fn n x)^2 * Real.log ((fn n x)^2) ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2) ∂μ)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖gradient (fn n) x‖^2 ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, ‖gradient f x‖^2 ∂μ))
approved_definition_context: The carriers and typeclasses have their usual Mathlib meanings: a real inner-product normed additive group, its compatible Borel measurable structure, and completeness. FiniteDimensional is present only where the displayed type says so.
ContDiff real 2 means globally twice continuously Frechet differentiable; the smooth infinity notation means C-infinity, not the distinct analytic omega order.
gradient is the literal Hilbert Riesz inverse of the real Frechet derivative of the given function. It is not an arbitrary supplied field or a chosen Radon-Nikodym representative.

MemLp g 2 mu means a.e. strong measurability and finite L2 seminorm; Integrable h mu means actual a.e. strong measurability and finite integral of the norm. Every integral displayed here is a real Bochner integral with respect to the indicated measure.

radialSmoothCutoff R x is the fixed function S(2-abs(norm(x)/R)), where S is Mathlib Real.smoothTransition. This is the fixed radial cutoff, not a quantified arbitrary family; only positive radii n+1 occur.

Real.log is the totalized real logarithm, with value0 at0. The real function q*log(q) is continuous at0. The subtraction in the displayed type is the literal homogeneous square-entropy formula, without a hidden normalization of mu.
